title: South32 sees limited risk of Indonesia replicating nickel success in alumina

title: Antam Posts 240% Net Profit Surge in 1H 2025, Fueled by Nickel Boom and Strong Gold Sales
body: PT Antam recorded a 240% jump in net profit to Rp5.14 trillion in the first half of 2025, driven by a nickel profit of Rp3.53 trillion and sales of Rp7.87 trillion, while gold sales rose 163% to Rp49.54 trillion. The company also achieved record quarterly nickel ore sales, expanded EV battery supply chain facilities, and advanced its ESG roadmap with a 15.8% scope 1&2 emission cut target and 75% land rehabilitation completion.

title: Indonesia Aims to Dominate Global Nickel Supply Chain Amid Production Expansion and Import Challenges
body: APNI's Meidy Katrin Lengkey highlighted Indonesia's 414,000‑ton nickel consumption and 54 operating smelters (plus 49 under construction) as the country positions itself to meet a projected 700‑million‑ton smelter demand, while noting reliance on Philippine imports for magnesium‑rich nickel and a shift of the 3‑year RKAB to a 1‑year cycle expected to start in 2026. She forecasted nickel prices at $15,000–$16,000 next year and urged government action to keep costs competitive and keep value‑added nickel within the country’s battery and stainless‑steel sectors.
